content: Reyansh Tiwari contacted insurance agent Karan Joshi to discuss auto insurance renewal options (Standard vs. Enhanced). Karan explained the coverage differences and pricing. Reyansh opted for the Enhanced plan and inquired about a home insurance bundle discount. Karan applied a 10% multi-policy discount, provided the updated quote PDF, and agreed to finalize the renewal and send a confirmation email.

action_items: Process the renewal for the Enhanced bundle
Send the confirmation email to the customer within the hour
